svg.title: SSEmaphore bounded saturation evidence
svg.desc: A terminal summary derived from one real fixed-seed production-path saturation run. It reports categorical accounting, capacity probes, oracle agreement, and explicit non-performance boundaries.

text.font-family: DejaVu Sans Mono, ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Consolas, monospace

svg.text: verified saturation projection without measured diagnostic intervals

svg.text: scope: one bounded synthetic numeric-loopback request-count saturation run
